name: CJ's Custom Apparel
old_description: CJ’s Custom Apparel has served Oklahoma since 2011, offering custom screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film printing, heat transfer printing, promotional products, graphic design, and so much more. As a family owned and operated business, we take great pride in providing the best quality products for our customers.
about:
CJ's Custom Apparel operates from Edmond, Oklahoma, where it was founded in 2011 as a family-owned and operated business. The company began by offering custom screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film printing, heat transfer printing, promotional products, and graphic design services to customers across Oklahoma.

The shop provides a range of apparel decoration processes including screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) transfers, digital printing, and heat transfer printing. It also supplies promotional products and offers in-house graphic design for artwork creation, vectorization, and digitizing. Wholesale DTF transfers are available for resellers. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

The company serves businesses, organizations, clubs, groups, bands, and events seeking custom apparel and promotional merchandise for branding and publicity. Its customer base is primarily local to Oklahoma, though it ships wholesale transfers more broadly.

As a family-owned operation, CJ's Custom Apparel emphasizes quality products and quality service, citing over a decade of experience as a differentiator. The company states it takes pride in delivering quality and exceptional service on every order.
